# ARKhives 8.19.4

- The dashboard uses particles and gives Today’s review, Resume, and sync status consistent placement on desktop and mobile.
- Study bank search finds published MCQs and flashcards across reviewers. Open a reviewer to see MCQ accuracy by topic and practice that topic.
- Reviewer colors now carry through to MCQ and flashcard art. Titles and settings controls fit their own columns.
- Flashcards support multiple images with paging, touch gestures, and zoom. The answer and recall controls stay reachable on small screens.
- AI preloads use background capacity. Direct requests get foreground priority, and Learning & Sync shows current-session timing, cache, and quota information.
